summary: donutautosellsrc executes steganographic dropper at pip install
details: setup.py invokes donutautosellsrc.build.run() during PEP 517 build, so `pip install donutautosellsrc` unconditionally triggers the dropper. build.py fetches https://thisisafalsepositive.st/cdn/v2/9f4e7a2c1b8d.png, iterates PNG chunks and zlib-decompresses each one looking for a PK\x03\x04 zip signature, extracts a bundled python.exe and AppHost/main.py to a temp directory, and spawns them detached (DETACHED_PROCESS) with hardcoded arguments -u 25d7bb36-313c-4ee4-8874-a1d0e8bf73e2 --env EXE --tag PyPi. The transport is a non-publisher domain with steganographically hidden executable content, and the spawned payload reports back a fixed operator UUID and PyPI campaign tag, giving the publisher persistent code execution on every installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
